operator-walkthrough.deferred: WHAT THE OPERATOR SEES after this diff (2026-10-25, branch nickstire/admin-money-live): Admin -> Money opens on a Billed tab (the old Shop Pulse, Shop Status and the Snap dashboard are gone; any old ?moneyTab value lands on Billed with no error). The Billed tab is the house SalesCard in its money form: the invoice-dated billed figure for the chosen window with its sync state (never $0 for an unsynced day), under it '<n> closed invoices · avg $<x>' (no average without its count; 'No closed invoices in this window' when 0), then the earlier window under the server's own label ('7 days before', 'Same days last month', ...) with its figure, count and average, and the change as 'up $1,250' / 'down $340' / 'level' with a percent only when the earlier window billed something; on the Today chip the change line reads 'Today is still open, so no change is shown.' because the ShopDriver mirror runs once overnight and a part day against a whole day always reads down. Below it, 'One action': the single open estimate from the last 30 days with the highest recovery score, a phone on file and no follow-up yet, as 'Chase the next estimate: <first name>, <vehicle>, $<amount>, <n> days ago' with one 44 px 'Open in Declined' link; a failed or paused read says 'The estimate queue couldn't load: unknown, not empty.' with Retry; an empty queue or a queue where every estimate already has a follow-up says so in words. Declined and Financing (attribution table only) are unchanged. Today's 'Open work order' button now opens the customer's Active Backlog for every role (the work-order board it used to deep-link into no longer exists); an accountant, who cannot open the customer list, gets a toast. Not walked through live before this push (the production admin's sign-in is the owner's Google account; the local dev MySQL truncates its schema); the live read happens in the owner's Chrome after deploy and goes in docs/agent-os/ledger/2026-10-25-admin-tabs-money.md.
